verdict.rationale: The 01 is described as an open-source platform. Its server, the 'brain' of the system, runs on your own computer, with Light and Livekit server variants and editable profiles for the language model and behavior, so the core product is self-hostable. Missing for 10: explicit install/deployment documentation in the evidence, evidence that it runs fully locally without cloud LLM APIs (the voice mode cited uses OpenAI's Realtime API), and independent hands-on corroboration of self-hosting.
